rules: Disposable DAW project only. No firmware or OS update, no "Burn To Flash", no factory reset, no storing patches.
Monitors and headphones low. If you hear loud noise or the Virus stops answering: stop the DAW, switch the Virus off and on, note the item.
Logging on (an empty file diag.on in the plug-in's folder); copy diag.log where the item says.
Core items (C1-C5) are the same every round and catch regressions; the round's own items follow them.

items.title: Core: cold start
steps: REAPER closed. Switch the Virus off, wait 5 s, switch it on, wait for its normal screen.
Open the test project (16ths at 120 BPM). When the start-up page is gone, play about 10 s.
items.expect: plays in time; the log has "Virus ready after" and "sync marker at frame", and no "audio stood still" line.

items.title: Core: reopen after the broker's idle exit (twice)
steps: Close REAPER, wait 60 s (pgrep -a vtibroker must show no broker), open the project, play about 10 s.
Do it once more (Virus stays on).
items.expect: both reopens play in time, no noise, no hang, no doubled notes.

items.title: Core: export
steps: Render the timing project with Full-speed offline to work/timing/LC3.wav. (After a wake, REAPER via PipeWire may need Preferences > Audio > Device re-applied, E211.)
items.expect: the export takes about as long as the clip; Claude measures the file (all notes on the grid).

items.title: Core: Virus off and on while the project is open
steps: Stopped, plug-in loaded: switch the Virus off, wait 10 s, switch it on, wait for its normal screen.
Press Play.
items.expect: the plug-in shows the Virus again within a few seconds and plays in time.

items.title: Core: sleep with the plug-in loaded
steps: Run systemctl suspend.
Wake it after about a minute, log in, press Play in REAPER.
Then copy the log: cp ~/.local/share/virus-ti-native/diag.log work/timing/L-diag.log.
items.expect: the Virus is heard again (a short "No Virus TI can be found" page in between is fine).
